text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambique and Sweden on Monday signed an agreement under which Sweden formally cancelled two-thirds of the debt service payments owed by Mozambique for the period 1995-1999. The amount of debt forgiven amounts to $4.1 million. A remaining $2 million has been resceduled over 23 years.

- Witnesses say a brigadier in the Mozambican armed forces stood by and watched as drunken soldiers savagely beat a 19- year-old Portuguese youth in Maputo at the weekend. The brigadier allegedly prevented the police from arresting those responsible. The youth, Frederico Silva e Sousa, was flown to hospital in South Africa on Sunday.
